mapper.select: SELECT D.CARD_ID AS cardId, D.DEVICE_ID AS deviceId, D.HANDLE_DATE_TIME AS handleDateTime, D.TICKET_TRANS_SEQ AS ticketTransSeq FROM QRCODE_TXN_DETAIL D WHERE D.TRX_TYPE IN ('02', '03') AND NVL(D.OVERTIME_AMOUNT, 0) > 0 AND D.TICKET_TRANS_SEQ IS NOT NULL AND D.TXN_DATE >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE - #{windowDays}, 'YYYYMMDD') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TBL_RISK_CONTROL_LOG X WHERE X.RULE_ID = #{ruleId} AND X.CARD_ID = D.CARD_ID AND X.USER_ORDER_NO = D.TICKET_TRANS_SEQ AND X.RISK_HIT_TIME >= SYSDATE - #{windowDays})

SELECT S.CARD_ID AS cardId, S.GATE_IN_TIME AS gateInTime, S.GATE_IN_STATION AS gateInStation FROM QRCODE_STATUS S WHERE S.CODE_STATUS = '04' AND S.GATE_IN_TIME <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE - #{stuckHours} / 24, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TBL_RISK_CONTROL_LOG X WHERE X.RULE_ID = #{ruleId} AND X.CARD_ID = S.CARD_ID AND X.USER_ORDER_NO IS NULL AND X.RISK_HIT_TIME >= SYSDATE - #{stuckHours} / 24)

SELECT K.CARD_ID AS cardId, K.TXN_DATE AS txnDate, K.EXIT_COUNT AS exitCount, K.LAST_EXIT_TIME AS lastExitTime, D2.TICKET_TRANS_SEQ AS lastExitSeq FROM ( SELECT D.CARD_ID AS CARD_ID, D.TXN_DATE AS TXN_DATE, COUNT(*) AS EXIT_COUNT, MAX(D.HANDLE_DATE_TIME) AS LAST_EXIT_TIME, MAX(D.ID) AS LAST_EXIT_ID FROM QRCODE_TXN_DETAIL D WHERE D.TRX_TYPE IN ('02', '03') AND D.TXN_DATE >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE - #{windowDays}, 'YYYYMMDD') GROUP BY D.CARD_ID, D.TXN_DATE HAVING COUNT(*) >= #{threshold} ) K JOIN QRCODE_TXN_DETAIL D2 ON D2.ID = K.LAST_EXIT_ID WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TBL_RISK_CONTROL_LOG X WHERE X.RULE_ID = #{ruleId} AND X.CARD_ID = K.CARD_ID AND TRUNC(X.RISK_HIT_TIME) = TO_DATE(K.TXN_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'))
